s1.note: Referrer must register online at hawthornbank.royalreferralcenter.com, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit a valid email address for both the referrer and each referred person or business.

s2.note: The referred person must not already have a Hawthorn Bank checking account; must open a new personal or business checking account within 90 days of the referral; personal: two or more direct deposits totaling at least $500 and keep the account open at least 60 days; business: two or more ACH transactions totaling at least $500 and keep the account open at least 60 days.

s3.note: Referrer may receive up to ten (10) direct deposits in increments of $50 ($500 value) within a calendar year; only one referrer per referred person/business (the first to submit).

s4.note: Reward is a $50 cash bonus via direct deposit into the referrer's Hawthorn Bank checking account; processing and delivery may take an additional 2-8 weeks after conditions are met. Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.

s5.note: Estimated 5-15 minutes of active time to register and submit referrals.
